stemMd: A plan is drawn at scale 1:100. A wall measures 6.5 cm on the plan. What is its real length?
explanationMd: Multiply the drawing length by100:6.5 cm becomes650 cm. Converting to metres gives6.5 m. Both the scale operation and unit conversion are necessary.

distractorRationale.d: This adds an extra factor of ten.
distractorRationale.b: This loses a factor of ten when converting centimetres to metres.
distractorRationale.c: The scaled result is650 centimetres, not metres.
